map.按玻璃面积/跨度与使用场景，推荐最小玻璃厚度，确保强度与安全。: Recommends the minimum glass thickness by glass area / span and use case, ensuring strength and safety
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：max(w,h)；w×h÷1e6: Core formula (by input variables): max(w,h); w×h÷1e6
map.门、桌台、护栏、淋浴隔断等涉及人身安全的部位应采用: Doors, tables and countertops, guardrails, shower partitions and other parts involving personal safety should use
map.（强度提升 3~5 倍，碎裂为钝角小颗粒）。: (3 to 5 times stronger, breaking into small blunt particles).
map.面积越大、跨度越长、风压/荷载越高，所需厚度越大。: The larger the area, the longer the span and the higher the wind pressure or load, the greater the required thickness.
map.本工具为常规民用场景的经验推荐，实际工程需按《建筑玻璃应用技术规程》JGJ 11: This tool gives empirical recommendations for ordinary civil use; real projects must verify strength and deflection according to the Technical Specification for Application of Architectural Glass, JGJ 113.
map.门窗选型：按面积推荐普通/钢化玻璃最小安全厚度: Door and window selection: recommended minimum safe thickness for ordinary and tempered glass by area
map.护栏/隔断：大跨度或安全场景要求钢化/夹胶厚度: Guardrails and partitions: large spans or safety scenarios require tempered or laminated thickness
map.下单依据：结合面积与最大跨度查表，避免偏薄失效: Ordering basis: look up the table by area and maximum span to avoid failures from glass that is too thin
map.算法：面积=宽×高/10⁶ (m²)，最大跨度=max(宽,高) (mm)；按场: Algorithm: area = width × height / 10⁶ (m²), maximum span = max(width, height) (mm); the minimum recommended thickness is looked up by scenario — windows: ≤ 0.8 m² → 3 mm, ≤ 1.5 → 4, ≤ 2.5 → 5, ≤ 3.5 → 6, ≤ 5 → 8, > 5 → ≥ 10 mm; glass doors: span ≤ 900 → 6 mm tempered, ≤ 1800 → 8, ≤ 2400 → 10, > 2400 → 12 mm tempered; shelves, desktops and partitions each have their own brackets. Non-window scenarios default to tempered. Requires dimensions > 0.
map.例1（窗户 800×1200mm）：面积 960000/1e6=0.96m²、跨: Example 1 (window 800 × 1200 mm): area 960000 / 1e6 = 0.96 m², span 1200 mm; 0.96 > 0.8 and ≤ 1.5 → 4 mm ordinary glass is usable. Example 2 (glass door 1500 × 2000 mm): area 3.00 m², span 2000 mm; span ≤ 2400 → 10 mm tempered glass recommended (safety scenarios must use tempered).
map.为什么门窗厚度规则不同？: Why are the thickness rules different for windows and doors?
map.窗户以面积定（风压与挠度随面积增大），普通采光可用普通玻璃；玻璃门/护栏涉及人身: Windows are sized by area (wind pressure and deflection grow with area) and ordinary glass can be used for daylighting; glass doors and guardrails involve personal safety, so they are sized by span and must be tempered or laminated, starting at 6 mm.
map.选型后能直接用吗？: Can the selection be used directly?
map.本表为快速估算与下单参考，实际工程须按《建筑玻璃应用技术规程》做风压、挠度与冲击: This table is for quick estimation and ordering reference; real projects must verify wind pressure, deflection and impact according to the Technical Specification for Application of Architectural Glass; large panels, high-rise buildings or crowded areas should use a higher grade and laminated safety glass.
